newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Nonferrous due to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: China Nonferrous due to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Shenzhen-based China Nonferrous Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it would list 18 million A shares and two million staff shares on the south China bourse on January 23.

The A shares were issued at 8.00 yuan each in Shenzhen earlier this month and the staff shares were offered at 2.00 yuan each in 1993, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The firm, a unit of the China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp, specialises in storage, transport and import and export of nonferrous metals.
China Nonferrous said it now has 80 million outstanding shares, composed of 42 million shares owned by institutions that founded the firm, the 20 million staff shares and 18 million A shares.
The two million new staff shares will become A shares after being listed, it said.
The company forecast net profits of 45.60 million yuan for 1997, compared with an estimated 35.08 million yuan for 1996 and 34.86 million yuan booked for 1995.

In a prospectus, the company said it would use 135 million yuan in net proceeds raised from the A share offer to finance a building materials project, expand its domestic jewelry sales network and supplement working capital for nonferrous metals foreign trade.
China National holds a 42 percent equity stake in China Nonferrous, which was set up in 1994 with a registered capital of 80 million yuan, according to the listing statement.
